archival_memory.espresso_machine_features: Espresso machines with a sleek, modern, stainless-steel finish are available with features like automatic temperature control, adjustable grind size, and programmable brewing options. Some models may also have additional features like Bluetooth connectivity, smartphone app control, and voice assistant integration. These machines are designed to provide a high-quality, café-like experience with minimal effort.
